name: zepto-telegram-stock-bot
description: Telegram bot that tracks stock and available quantity for one Zepto product at one pincode.

scripts.lint: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),vm=require('vm'),path=require('path');let n=0;for(const d of ['src','scripts'])for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d))if(f.endsWith('.js')){const p=path.join(d,f);new vm.Script(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'),{filename:p});n++;}JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8'));console.log('Syntax OK ('+n+' JS files).')"
